dict.string: NIGHTLY routing-flywheel live run (Stuart, 2026-07-17: "go live with this"). Runs scripts/routing-flywheel.mjs --live once per night: rUv's @metaharness/flywheel engine evolves the routing executor policy against the accumulated labelled outcomes, under HARD caps the script itself clamps (proposer spend ≤ $0.50, wall clock ≤ 10 min, ≤ 6 generations — the self-DDoS lesson encoded). A promotion NEVER touches live routing: it writes ~/.claude/model-router/policy.candidate.mjs with a signed Ed25519 receipt chain for HUMAN review (frozen gate, anchor suite — ADR-226: no advisor, promote only proven changes). OPENROUTER_API_KEY is sourced from the repo .env at run time, never stored here. Nightly, not more often: the gate only has something new to judge as labelled outcomes accumulate. Wrapped in job-heartbeat.sh per the house positive-confirmation pattern (config/ scheduled-jobs.json + nightly-watchdog.mjs) — silence is not health.
